title: GHURBAT ME FATIMA KA AABAAD GHAR LUTA HAI
body:
Ye Karbala me Akhtar kya saaneha huwa hai
Laashe pade hain Kiske khoo'n Kiska ye baha hai
Thehre nazar jaha'n bhi manzar lahu bhara hai
Maida'n ka zarra zarra aawaz deraha hai
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dashte bala mei sab ne shaadi ka sog dekha
Kubra banithi dulhan Qasim bana tha dulha
Paamal ran e Dulha taza Dulhan hai bewa
Kaandhe pa Shahe Dee'n ke Noushah ka hai Laasha
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaime ke dar pa bachche kooze liye khade hain
Abbas sar se paa'n tak khoo'n me naha gaye hain
Mashkiza chhid gaya hai Shaane kate huwe hain
Thame huwe kamar ko Shabbir Rorahe hain
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yu'n Akbare Jawa'n ki maqtal se Laash aayi
Seene pa zakhm taaza zulfo'n me khaak ran ki
Allah Jaanta hai Zainab pa jo bhi guzri
Ye Sonchti hai Laila Kis tarha ab jiyegi
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabbir Laashe Asghar khaime me aise laay
Pyaase Gaye the rann ko khoo'n me Nahake Aay
Honto pa Muskurahat Gardann pa teer khaay
Doure khiza me jaise ek phool muskuraay
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Koofe me daakhila bhi uftaad ek nayi thi
Bedard rasto'n par Aulad Mustafa ki
Sahmi Huwi Sakina Ankhon me ek udaasi
Zainab ki beridayi Sajjad ki aseeri
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbar shaam ka tha aur Qafela khada tha
Sardare Dojaha'n ka Sar tasht me rakha tha
Honto'n pa Shahe Dee'n ke wo zulm ho raha tha
Zainab ke Tanbadan me larza pada huwa tha
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Bigdi huwi wo Duniya badla huwa zamana
Kamsin Yateem Bachchi zalim ka taaziyana
Roshan Zameer Qaidi taarik qaid khana
Maa peet'ti rahi sar aur chal basi Sakina
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab Arbaeen karne Kunba Nabi ka pohncha
Maidane Karbala me ek hashr ka sama tha
Qabre Hussain kaampi Maatam ka shor utha
Zainab Suna Rahi thi rudaade shaam 0 Kufa
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Beete huwe dino ke sab zakhm ab haray the
Zainab ye Sonchti thi Haathon se Dil ko Thaame
Abbbas ki Lahad par Jaaungi ab Main kaise
Zindaa'n me hai Sakina aankhon me hai'n andhere
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Marqad pa Shahe Dee'n ke Naale Rabab ke the
Jaakar watan ye Dukhiya rudad kya Sunaay
Waris nahi'n hai Sar par Bachche bhi Mujhse bichhde
Apni Lahad me Waali Mujhko bhi ab chhipaale
<<MINI>>
Ghurbat me Fatima ka aabaad Ghar luta hai
author: Akhtar Zaidi
